entries.description: Commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and generating commit messages.
entries.summary: 在对话里提交工作区改动，由模型分组并生成 Git 提交信息。
entries.summaryEn: Commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and generating commit messages.
entries.title: Git 提交

entries.description: Per-session Delegation Mode: the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work, enabling multi-agent orchestration.
entries.summary: 按会话开启委派模式：主代理负责拆解、委派和验收，子代理执行具体任务，支持多智能体协作。
entries.summaryEn: Per-session Delegation Mode: the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work, enabling multi-agent orchestration.
entries.title: 委派模式

entries.description: Session titles follow the latest task automatically; names you set by hand stay put. Auto-rename and manual naming coexist.
entries.summary: 会话标题跟随最新任务自动更新，手动改过的名字不会被覆盖；自动重命名与人工命名两不误。
entries.summaryEn: Session titles follow the latest task automatically; names you set by hand stay put. Auto-rename and manual naming coexist.
entries.title: 自动标题

entries.description: Manage and rank web search and page-reading providers (DuckDuckGo, Exa, Tavily, Brave, Bocha, Serper, Firecrawl, Perplexity, Jina, and plugin sources) in one settings page for web_search and web_fetch.
entries.summary: 在一个设置页管理和排序联网搜索与网页读取（抓取）服务，内置 DuckDuckGo、Exa、Tavily 等，并整合其他插件的搜索源，为模型提供 web_search 与 web_fetch。
entries.summaryEn: Manage and rank web search and page-reading providers (DuckDuckGo, Exa, Tavily, Brave, Bocha, Serper, Firecrawl, Perplexity, Jina, and plugin sources) in one settings page for web_search and web_fetch.
entries.title: 网页搜索

entries.description: Search Zhihu and the web, check hot lists, Zhida AI answers, Q&A, comments, knowledge bases, creator stats, and quotas, and manage article, question, and pin drafts with image uploads.
entries.summary: 知乎站内与全网搜索、热榜、Zhida 直答、知识库、问题推荐与回答摘要、内容与评论读取、创作数据与额度统计，以及草稿管理和配图上传。
entries.summaryEn: Search Zhihu and the web, check hot lists, Zhida AI answers, Q&A, comments, knowledge bases, creator stats, and quotas, and manage article, question, and pin drafts with image uploads.
entries.title: 知乎

entries.description: Browse official DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; the agent gets two read-only tools to search docs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (dsh_docs, dsh_plugins).
entries.summary: 在插件页浏览 DSH 官方开发文档；智能体获得两个只读工具检索文档与核对插件（dsh_docs、dsh_plugins）。
entries.summaryEn: Browse official DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; the agent gets two read-only tools to search docs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (dsh_docs, dsh_plugins).
entries.title: DSH 文档

entries.description: Adds a Safe Auto approval level: a reviewer model answers approval requests one call at a time, with full review history and audit trails.
entries.summary: 新增「Safe Auto」审批档位：需要审批的请求交给审核模型判断，通过才放行，并记录完整的审核历史。
entries.summaryEn: Adds a Safe Auto approval level: a reviewer model answers approval requests one call at a time, with full review history and audit trails.
entries.title: Safe Auto

entries.description: Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current session or message other sessions.
entries.summary: 跨工作目录搜索和阅读 DeepSeek Harness 会话，使用临时工作区；空输入一键续写或自动继续，久离回来给出摘要与上下文压缩建议；可选择让 agent 分叉当前会话或向其他会话发送消息。
entries.summaryEn: Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current session or message other sessions.
entries.title: 会话管理

entries.description: Configure the model and reasoning effort for subagents, and see each one's last-used model in the conversation popup.
entries.summary: 配置子代理的模型与推理强度（思考强度），并在会话弹层查看最后使用的模型。
entries.summaryEn: Configure the model and reasoning effort for subagents, and see each one's last-used model in the conversation popup.
entries.title: 子代理

entries.description: Customize the interface, conversation, code and terminal fonts and font sizes of the Web GUI; change font families and adjust typography.
entries.summary: 自定义 Web GUI 的界面、对话、代码与终端字体及字号，支持更换字体族与调整排版。
entries.summaryEn: Customize the interface, conversation, code and terminal fonts and font sizes of the Web GUI; change font families and adjust typography.
entries.title: 字体

entries.description: A session preset that removes the model's answer limits and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it; may get your account banned.
entries.summary: 解除模型回答限制并交付完整成果的会话预设（Preset），只作用于选用它的会话；可能导致账号被封禁。
entries.summaryEn: A session preset that removes the model's answer limits and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it; may get your account banned.
entries.title: 破限

entries.description: Hides the plugin-info and promotion cards at the top of the dsh-context dashboard.
entries.summary: 隐藏 dsh-context 仪表盘顶部的插件信息与推广卡片。
entries.summaryEn: Hides the plugin-info and promotion cards at the top of the dsh-context dashboard.
entries.title: 上下文面板清理

entries.description: Charts, metrics, tables and safe local inputs in replies, with validated answers to show_view cards.
entries.summary: 在回复中展示图表、指标、表格和安全联动的本地输入；show_view 可接收已校验的用户回答。
entries.summaryEn: Charts, metrics, tables and safe local inputs in replies, with validated answers to show_view cards.
entries.title: Deep View 回复卡片

entries.description: Searchable model selection with a reasoning-effort slider in the composer; other plugins can reuse the same picker.
entries.summary: 输入框里的模型搜索与推理档位滑杆；其他插件可复用同一选择器。
entries.summaryEn: Searchable model selection with a reasoning-effort slider in the composer; other plugins can reuse the same picker.
entries.title: 模型选择器
